findings.note: The success criterion does not measure the required sequence of addressing conditional-review requirements and then recording explicit owner approval.
This success criterion omits the case where the last review point or source status cannot be established, despite FR-006 requiring uncertainty to be recorded and revalidation requested.
“Review point” lacks a minimum definition for making staleness auditable.
No success criterion verifies that existing shared diagram files remain unchanged in this refactor.
The checklist claims full testability and measurable outcomes despite the identified gaps above.
